description: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain (Silicon Knights / Crystal Dynamics 1996, GOG, via Proton)
long: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain is a top-down action-adventure RPG that launched the Legacy of Kain series. The player controls the vampire Kain on a dark quest for revenge across the gothic world of Nosgoth, using swords, spells, and shapeshifting abilities. It is known for its mature storytelling and atmospheric narration.
